scope: Inspection of the supplied Badro SI and Garberoglio full text, source-parameter comparison, and update of the pending-source list. No default coefficient, interpolation, runtime domain or historical receipt is changed.
source_storage: Original PDFs and complete table transcriptions remain local under refs/, which is excluded by .git/info/exclude. Repository records contain hashes, scoped findings and numerical comparison results.

previous_review.history_policy: Previous access outcomes and the seven-item bibliography remain historical and unchanged.

badro2015.identity: Supporting Information, PDF title Badro_SIAppendix, author James Badro; core-formation model and parameter table correspond to the supplied 2015 main paper.
badro2015.inspection: Section 1a, PDF pp.1-3: partition definition, Eqs.1-4, temperature scaling and all six rows of the parameter table; Section 1c, p.4: uncertainty procedure; references 1-3, p.12.
badro2015.parameter_table_locator: PDF p.3, table introduced in the preceding paragraph as Table S1. Use this page and the epsilon_i^O/epsilon_i^Si column headings to distinguish it from the later model-output tables.

conventions.partition: D_i=X_i_metal/X_i_silicate with molar concentrations (Eq.1). Eq.2 parameterizes log(D_i); Eqs.3-4 use natural-log metal activity coefficients.
conventions.temperature_scaling: epsilon_i^j(T)=(1873/T)*epsilon_i^j(1873 K). Reference temperature is not a calibration domain.
conventions.solvent: Eq.3 computes ln(gamma_Fe); Eq.4 includes that solvent term. The supplement does not impose gamma_Fe=1.
conventions.standard_states: Eq.4 carries ln(gamma_i^0) as the infinite-dilution limit in Fe. These coefficients do not supply absolute pure-component chemical potentials or justify formal pure-Si/O continuation.

oxygen_comparison.interpretation: The original parameter source supports the author/GCE code value for this coefficient. The -16500/T term still belongs in ln(gamma_O^0); it is distinct from epsilon_O^O. This establishes ancestry, not an author-issued correction or empirical validation of either full equilibrium solver.
oxygen_comparison.after_solvent_completion: Let delta_b=(-16500+1873)/T. Differences in source-convention ln gamma are delta_b*(x_O+ln(1-x_O)) for Fe and Si, and delta_b*x_O for O.

numerical_comparison.reference_algebra: The existing Decimal generator was visually compared with SI Eqs.3-4; its parameters were copied in memory and only epsilon_OO_times_temperature_K was set to -1873.
numerical_comparison.meaning: Existing custom-parameter API and explicit standard conversion reproduce the source algebra at numerical fixture states. This does not identify experimental calibration points or change the default model version.

calibration_scope.ancestry: The paragraph above Table S1 attributes the regressions to Siebert et al. (2012,2013), SI references 3 and 2, using piston-cylinder, multi-anvil and laser-heated diamond-anvil experiments.
reference_titles: Metal-silicate partitioning of Ni and Co in a deep magma ocean (2012)
calibration_scope.uncertainty: Table S1 gives parenthesized errors for regression a,b,c. Section 1c samples their normal distributions in 100000 Monte Carlo trials per accretion step and describes 1-sigma and 2-sigma output spreads. No parameter covariance matrix or uncertainty entries for the listed epsilon/ln_gamma0 values are provided in this table.
calibration_scope.remaining: The SI does not supply all individual underlying calibration observations or a validated joint Fe-Si-O T/P/composition/error domain. The 0-135 GPa accretion-model sweep is a model exploration, not such a calibration rectangle.

badro2015.status: Supplied supplement and coefficient ancestry inspected. Default-version selection, calibration replay and empirical applicability remain open.

bibliography.title: Fully Quantum Cross Second Virial Coefficients for the Three-Dimensional He-H2 Pair

garberoglio2014.inspection: Title/DOI; Sections 2.1-2.3, pp.1437-1440; Section 3 and all 67 Table 1 rows, pp.1440-1442; Section 4 and Eq.3, p.1444; Section 5, p.1448. Table 1 was visually checked on both pages.
garberoglio2014.species: 4He with molecular H2; the authors quantum-statistical nuclear-exchange treatment is retained. Isotopologues are separate Tables 2-3.
garberoglio2014.quantity: Density cross second virial coefficient B12(T), in cm3/mol. The fully flexible PIMC result is column 2; columns 4-5 are rigid-rotor comparisons.

uncertainty.meaning: Expanded uncertainty from potential and PIMC statistical contributions combined in quadrature; approximately 95 percent coverage under the authors assumptions, not a strict bound on a full gas EOS.

garberoglio2014.conversion_and_mixture_convention: Multiply B12 by 1e-6 for m3/mol. It is the symmetric pair entry used in B_mix=sum_i sum_j x_i*x_j*B_ij; the binary cross contribution is 2*x_H2*x_He*B12. It is not the excess quantity B12_ex=B12-(B11+B22)/2 defined in Eq.3.
garberoglio2014.provider_status: The historical gas_virial_sources.json abstract-only entry and saved diagnostic remain unchanged. The current source gap is closed by this dated inspection. gas_virial.py still requires explicit H2-He input; this task adds no interpolation, extrapolation or new runtime selection.
garberoglio2014.remaining: The saved M2 point at 2173.15 K is above the table maximum. The paper does not supply that value or a high-temperature extrapolation error. A second virial alone also leaves higher density virials, trace pairs and dense-mixture accuracy unbounded.
garberoglio2014.status: Full text, numerical table and uncertainty convention inspected; no finite-density or beyond-table validation is inferred.
